title: NBN POI 4ROT (Rockhampton) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Scheduled maintenance at the Rockhampton (4ROT) POI completed at 2:00 AM AEST on 5 August 2026 (2026-08-04T16:00:00Z). Services affected by this maintenance should now be operating normally. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support.

updates.content: We will be performing planned maintenance on our network affecting some nbn services delivered via the Rockhampton (4ROT) POI. The maintenance window is from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 5 August 2026. During this time, services may briefly drop as we move connections to a new router. We will work to keep any interruption as short as possible and will monitor throughout the window.

Scheduled maintenance at the Rockhampton (4ROT) POI has completed. The vendor's update indicates the work finished at 2:00 AM AEST on 5 August 2026 (2026-08-04T16:00:00Z). Services affected by this maintenance should now be operating normally.
